mx_handoff: The DW P1 transport envelope is decoded inside the app. MX receives the clean final HTTP(S) URL, request headers and HLS MIME application/x-mpegURL.
playback_extractor_rule: mov/webm/embed always resolve through the original Q0/S0 extractor path; m3u8 is direct only when the supplied URL itself ends with .m3u8; mp4/mkv/mpd are direct.
quality_selection: Multiple extractor results show the original R0/a quality names. The selected stream is decoded/validated again before MX handoff.
server_labels: Restored original Drama World labels for quick-play, multi-quality, HD, direct, YouTube and download server rows.
download_access_rule: Only Drama flags 2 and 3 are restricted; 0, 1 and empty are public, matching the original APK.
external_download_rule: For source.external=true, mp4 is direct while mkv/mov/m3u8/webm use the original extractor path. source.external=false is direct.
known_limitations: Some providers are already unavailable in the original Drama World app, and providers depending on protected remote extractor configuration can still fail. This build fixes the clean-URL/MX handoff and original routing/quality labels, but each live provider still needs real-phone testing.
